enabled.description: Whether to start the dhcp-helper service on boot.

servers.description: List of destination DHCP server addresses (IP or hostname).

interfaces.description: List of network interfaces on which to listen for DHCP requests.

port.description: UDP port on which to listen for incoming DHCP requests.

max_packet.description: Maximum packet size in bytes to accept (RFC recommends 576 for relay, but many networks use larger).

source_addr.description: Source IP address to use when relaying packets to servers. Leave empty to let the system choose.

extra_opts.description: Additional command-line flags for the dhcp-helper binary (e.g., ['-d'] for debug mode).

syslog_facility.description: Syslog facility to use for logging (e.g., daemon, local0–local7).

log_level.description: Verbosity level for logging (debug, info, notice, warning, error, crit, alert, emerg).

drop_invalid_checksums.description: Whether to drop packets with invalid IP/UDP checksums (recommended for security and reliability).

dhcp_helper_extra_opts.description: Complete command-line options string passed to dhcp-helper, combining servers, interfaces, and other flags.
